label: Krea 2 - Character + canonical outfit
description: Binds both character design and the recurring signature outfit to [trigger].
prompt: Write one natural-language training caption for a Krea 2 character LoRA whose canonical outfit is part of the identity. Refer to the target exactly once as '[trigger] character' within the first sentence. Describe only what is visibly present: framing, pose or action, expression and gaze, temporary props or non-signature accessories, setting and background, lighting, and medium or rendering style when relevant. Treat the character's intrinsic face, anatomy, species traits, permanent markings, signature colors, and recurring canonical outfit as core identity and do not enumerate them; they must be learned through [trigger]. Do not identify a copyrighted or public character by name. Do not infer hidden or off-frame details. Return one plain paragraph of approximately 30-90 words. Do not output JSON, keys, lists, bounding boxes, coordinates, hex colors, analysis, caveats, or introductory text. Preserve the literal token [trigger] exactly.
